Search terms for this lesson“how do I refine ladder colliders and finish my cave for the boss?”Outline only

Quick polish + Cave Level Studio. Verify the collider edge cases on your 7.3 ladders (top ledge alignment, overlapping triggers, and prefab reuse), then put the bulk of your effort into shaping your cave toward the boss fight.

Break It Down~10 minOutline only

Keep ladder tops and bottoms clean without falling through floors, then spend studio time finishing your cave.

First, before any code: cut that into parts small enough that you could look each one up on its own.

  1. Align the Ladder trigger height to the top ledgewhat does this part do?Read: 7.3 (BoxCollider2D trigger boundaries on Ladder objects)
  2. Verify exit behavior when stepping off onto Groundwhat does this part do?Read: 6.2 (OnCollisionEnter2D() resetting jumpsRemaining on CompareTag("Ground"))
  3. Playtest the full cave traversal loopwhat does this part do?Read: 7.5 (Flow & Difficulty pacing checklist before boss week)

Almost every ladder bug after 7.3 is collider placement, not C#: if the trigger ends two pixels below a ledge you drop back into the pit on exit, and if a moving platform touches a ladder they can fight over control.

Your turn

Pick two of the parts above and say in one line what each one actually does.

Why does ending the ladder trigger slightly ABOVE the top floor surface make stepping onto the upper ledge reliable?

If two ladder triggers overlap end-to-end and the player climbs from one into the other, what can OnTriggerExit2D() from the first ladder accidentally do to isPlatformer?

Before continuing level studio: where in your cave should the double-jump / boss upgrade gate sit so players feel rewarded for climbing and platforming?

In the Editor: Ladder Collider Checks (~10 min) ~10 min
SymptomCauseEditor / Code Fix
Falls right before reaching the upper platform Trigger box stops slightly below the floor collider top edge Extend the ladder BoxCollider2D slightly above the upper ledge so OnTriggerExit2D() runs only after your feet clear the edge.
Touching two stacked ladders drops the player halfway up Exiting ladder #1 runs OnTriggerExit2D() and sets isPlatformer = true while still inside ladder #2 Use one tall ladder trigger per shaft instead of stacking separate triggers on top of each other.
Player cannot jump right after stepping off a ladder onto thin platforms Still touching side wall or missed "Ground" collision Confirm the landing ledge carries the Ground tag and solid collider so OnCollisionEnter2D() refills jumpsRemaining.

Socratic: Collider Geometry & Level Flow

  1. Why is one scaled BoxCollider2D safer than three stacked Ladder trigger objects inside the same vertical shaft?
  2. What happens if you jump past a decorative ladder that sits in the background behind a main combat jump? Should decorative art carry the Ladder tag or remain untagged without a trigger?
  3. How does combining a ladder shaft, a moving Platform, and a TurretController teach a player what skills they will need in your upcoming boss fight?
In the Code + Studio: Build Your Cave & Boss Prep (~55 min) ~55 min

Double-check that your PlayerController.cs trigger logic is saved as a clean reusable pattern on the Player prefab (isPlatformer = false; rb.gravityScale = 0; on enter, isPlatformer = true; rb.gravityScale = gravityScale; on exit), then build:

  • Complete the main route: make sure a player can traverse smoothly from the cave entrance to the far room using jumps, moving platforms, and ladders.
  • Place combat & resource beats: reward tricky high ledges with coins or health potions so exploration pays off before the boss.
  • Carve out your Boss Arena space: leave a clear doorway or flat/tiered room at the end of the cave so your boss encounter fits cleanly after Thanksgiving Break.

Checkpoint — before moving on, you must be able to:

  • Climb smoothly off the top and bottom of every ladder without getting stuck or falling early
  • Avoid stacked overlapping ladder triggers in the same shaft
  • Complete a playable route through your cave with room carved out for the boss fight
  • Commit and push
